metadata.description: Gist plugins for Claude: one plugin per Gist app, each with skills and the app's MCP connector.

plugins.name: gist-calendar
plugins.description: See your schedule, find free time and manage events in Gist Calendar.

plugins.name: gist-crm
plugins.description: Look up and update contacts, companies, deals and activities in Gist CRM.

plugins.name: gist-drive
plugins.description: Find, organize and share files and folders in Gist Drive.

plugins.name: gist-mail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft and send email from your Gist Mail mailboxes.

plugins.name: gist-sheets
plugins.description: Read, analyze and update spreadsheets in Gist Sheets.

plugins.name: gist-support
plugins.description: Triage, answer and manage customer support tickets in Gist Support.

plugins.name: gist-teams
plugins.description: Catch up on team chat and manage boards, cards and docs in Gist Teams.
